description: Obsidian links. [[inner]] is a link; ![[inner]] is an embed. The inner text splits on the first | (alias, or an embed's size), then on the first # of what's left: #^ gives a block id, # a heading. The target is what precedes, trimmed of spaces and tabs. An empty target ([[#Heading]]) is an open decision: see spec/README.md. Inner text never holds [, ] or a line break.
